environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime, x86_64) deployed behind API Gateway REST API with no request validation. Lambda execution role has AmazonS3FullAccess and AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole. Function runs with default Lambda runtime configuration. API Gateway has no request body validation or WAF attached. Lambda has 512MB memory, 30s timeout, /opt layer contains pandoc binary.
